limitations: The classification covers only grid heights two and three, with at least two columns. Computer-independent proof checking and independent historical-priority verification have not been performed.
scientific_integrity: A finite-state identity plus an exact linear induction proves the infinite claims; direct small cases are cross-checks only. The older bipartite uniqueness result is acknowledged as covering one aspect of the odd-area subcase, and no independent certification is claimed.
title: Rigidity of maximum minimal dominating sets in two- and three-row grids
